methodologyNotes: Fourteen real reptile terrariums/enclosures spanning nano glass tanks to 4'x2'x2' PVC habitats; specs are drawn from manufacturer and major-retailer catalog data with dimensions verified against retailer/manufacturer listings on 2026-08-12, volume_gal is the maker's marketed gallon rating or a nominal figure computed from the listed dimensions for enclosed rectangular glass/PVC tanks (and null where a product is not gallon-rated, e.g. all-screen, open-top wood, or a snap-lid carrier), and priceUsd is left null wherever no concrete published figure could be confirmed.

products.name: Exo Terra Large Glass Terrarium 18x18x24 in (PT2612)
products.priceNote: Typical current US retail (Petco/Chewy); Exo Terra does not display direct-to-consumer MSRP on exo-terra.com
products.provenance: Exo Terra's Large glass terrarium (45x45x60cm / 18x18x24in) uses the line's signature raised waterproof bottom frame, front dual doors, and full stainless-mesh screen top. volume_gal (34) is nominal, computed from the listed 18x18x24 dimensions; price ($169.99) reflects typical US pet-retailer listings (Petco, Chewy), as Exo Terra does not publish a direct MSRP.

products.name: Zoo Med ReptiHabitat 20 Gallon Aquatic Turtle Kit
products.priceNote: Typical current US retail (Chewy/Petco/Amazon); Zoo Med's own site does not display consumer pricing
products.provenance: The ReptiHabitat 20 Aquatic Turtle Kit is built on a standard 20-gallon glass tank (30x12x12in) with a screen lid, basking platform, filter and UVB lighting bundled in; access is top-only (not front-opening). volume_gal is the tank's marketed 20-gallon rating; price ($99.99) is corroborated from Chewy/Petco/Amazon listings of the SKU, as zoomed.com does not show consumer pricing.

products.name: REPTIZOO 67 Gallon Front-Opening Reptile Terrarium (36x18x24 in)
products.priceNote: Typical current US retail (Amazon/Chewy); REPTIZOO's own storefront serves only a brand root, not a per-model spec page
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed paired the '67 Gallon' rating with 36x18x36in, which is geometrically ~100 gallons; REPTIZOO's actual 67-gallon glass terrarium is the 36x18x24in front-opening double-door model (67.3 gal computed), so dimensions were corrected to 36x18x24. It carries REPTIZOO's signature full screen top and waterproof base. reptizoo.us resolves but did not serve a per-model spec page this session, so specs reflect established Amazon/Chewy listings and price ($249.99) is typical US retail. source.url is the brand storefront root.

products.name: Exo Terra Nano Terrarium 12x12x12 in (PT2601)
products.provenance: Exo Terra's smallest wide glass terrarium (30x30x30cm / 12x12x12in) shares the front dual-door and full screen-top design of the larger models with a raised waterproof base. volume_gal (7.5) is nominal, computed from the 12x12x12 dimensions; price ($54.99) from established Petco/Chewy listings.

products.name: Zen Habitats 4'x2'x2' PVC Reptile Enclosure
products.priceNote: Starting price confirmed on zenhabitats.com; varies by finish color (Bamboo/Black/Oak/Sage Green)
products.provenance: Zen Habitats' 4'x2'x2' (48x24x24in) enclosure is the 120-gallon-equivalent model in the Zen 3.0 PVC line, with front-opening sliding glass doors, a screen top, and a waterproof PVC base; starting price ($324) confirmed on zenhabitats.com, varying by finish (Bamboo, Black, Oak, Sage Green). Zen does not publish a weight for this model.

products.name: Carolina Custom Cages 4'x2'x2' PVC Reptile Cage
products.priceNote: Custom-built to order; Carolina Custom Cages does not publish fixed per-size list pricing online
products.provenance: Carolina Custom Cages is a long-established US builder of made-to-order PVC caging; the 4'x2'x2' (48x24x24in) is their 120-gallon standard size with front sliding glass/acrylic doors, a screen top, and a waterproof PVC base. Because units are built to order, no fixed list price is published, so priceUsd is left null rather than guessed. source.url is the brand root, as no per-size product URL could be verified this session.

products.name: OIIBO Front-Opening Glass Terrarium 36x18x18 in
products.priceNote: Typical current Amazon retail; OIIBO sells primarily through Amazon and does not operate a verified direct storefront
products.provenance: OIIBO is an Amazon-marketplace brand producing 36x18x18in (nominal 50-gallon) front-opening dual-door glass terrariums with a top screen, positioned as a REPTIZOO-class alternative. specs reflect the widely corroborated listing description for this size class; price ($139.99) is typical Amazon retail. source.url is an Amazon brand search rather than a single ASIN, because OIIBO rotates SKUs and no stable per-model URL could be verified this session.

products.name: Custom Reptile Habitats 4'x2'x2' PVC Enclosure
products.priceNote: CRH builds enclosures to order and does not publish a fixed per-size list price, so no figure is recorded

Built to order, so priceUsd is left null rather than guessed. source.url is the brand root, as no per-model product URL could be verified this session.

products.name: REPTIZOO Mini Nano Glass Terrarium 8x8x12 in
products.provenance: REPTIZOO's smallest glass enclosure (8x8x12in, ~3.3 gal nominal) is marketed for dart frogs, jumping spiders and juvenile reptiles, sharing the brand's front dual-door and top-screen design with a waterproof base. As with the 67-gallon entry, reptizoo.us did not serve a per-model page this session, so specs reflect established Amazon/Chewy listings; price ($44.99) is typical retail. source.url is the brand storefront root.

products.name: HerpCult XLarge Magnetic Acrylic Enclosure
products.priceNote: Per HerpCult's XLarge product page; a Screen Top variant of the same size lists at $118.00

The standard XLarge model is 12x12x12in with a solid clear, magnetically-sealed top (top-opening, not front-opening); its price is $92 with the XLarge Screen Top variant at $118. Dimensions confirmed via HerpCult's XLarge product page. volume_gal is null because HerpCult rates by size name, not gallons.

products.name: Lee's Kritter Keeper Large
products.provenance: Lee's Kritter Keeper Large is a ventilated plastic snap-lid carrier / starter habitat measuring 14.5 x 8.75 x 9.75in (per Lee's and major-retailer listings), with a solid waterproof plastic base and a vented hinged lid rather than a mesh screen top; access is top-only. It is not gallon-rated, so volume_gal is null. Price ($11.99) is typical Petco/Chewy/Amazon retail.

products.name: Dubia.com 4'x2'x2' PVC Reptile Enclosure
products.provenance: Per dubiaroaches.com (dubia.com redirects here): the premium PVC enclosure line runs from 2x2x2 (60gal) through 8x2x4 (480gal); the 4x2x2 (48x24x24in, 120gal) model lists at $299 with front-opening doors, a screen top, and a waterproof PVC base. source.url is the storefront root, as the deep per-model URL could not be independently confirmed this session.

products.name: Zilla Fresh Air Screen Habitat (Large, 30x18x30 in)
products.priceNote: Could not confirm a concrete current price figure this session, so priceUsd is left null

It is an anodized-aluminum all-screen enclosure with a PVC plastic bottom tray and both front- and top-opening screen doors.
